Not sure how this is fat hate. At the gym I'll sometimes have some candy after doing a ball busting 90 min cardio session. And I sure as hell am not fat.

How can you eat candy after going to the gym? This isn't meant to 'food shame' you or anything. I'm actually curious.

Usually after I've worked out I only want water or fruit. Sometimes I want something like Mc Donalds, but that's only if I work out when I haven't eaten all day, and I only buy something small off the value menu. Craving something salty after a workout seems kind of natural... I know "intuitive eating" is usually an excuse for fatties to eat whatever they want, but I notice my cravings tie in with what's happening with my body or what I haven't been eating enough of at any given time.

Processed sugar will instantly re-energize you after a grueling gym session. You can eat processed sugar in moderation and it's not really a big deal. I love eating a Reece's cups after a workout, it's only 17g of sugar (relative to soda/other candies which would be in the 40s) and is a nice treat.
Maybe I'm weird... When I do drugs like MDMA I can't eat candy either. I've been offered candy, taken it, and had to spit it out because it was just too much for my body to handle.

After a high intensity 90 min cardio workout, carbs and sugars are perfectly fine and often necessary. I usually eat Shot Bloks. Same as when I'm in bike races. Seeing as I usually expend around 1500 calories after 90 min high intensity, sugars are a very welcomed relief.
